title: Ship of Magic
author: Robin Hobb
summary: In the trading city of Bingtown, the Vestrit family owns a liveship, a vessel carved from magical wood that wakes up after generations. The first Liveship Traders book follows the family's struggle over the ship, with pirates and sea serpents in the background.
readIf: you like slow, character-heavy fantasy with a strong sea setting and family rivalries.
skipIf: you want a fast plot, as this one builds slowly through many viewpoints.

pairings.reason: Hobb's most beloved series, set in the same wider world but with a quieter, more personal focus.
Another fantasy with a busy port city and plenty of scheming, with more humour.
Another large, complex fantasy with several women at its heart and a wide political canvas.
